description: Coverage accounting. 'quarantine' lists tests that no CI leg executes, each with an owner, a review date and the gap it leaves; the Safety evidence job fails on any other never-executed test. 'dispositions' explain removed or weakened coverage; check_coverage_regression.py accepts only dispositions added by the same change. See docs/rules/safety-evidence.md.

quarantine.reason: Collation.Default snapshots the culture once per process, so the test passes only as the first LiteDB use in the process; after another test created a database it sees that culture instead of 'fi'.
quarantine.gap: A new database taking its collation from the current thread culture is not asserted on any CI leg; product behaviour (process-wide snapshot) decides whether the test can be made order-independent.

quarantine.reason: Not supported yet: rebuilding 'ana'/'ANA' from en-US/None to en-US/IgnoreCase throws 'Cannot insert duplicate key' instead of recording the collision in _rebuild_errors.
quarantine.gap: Rebuilding to a collation under which unique keys collide is not exercised; the expected _rebuild_errors behaviour is not implemented.

quarantine.reason: Takes ~102 s (100 iterations with a 1 s sleep; passed 5/5 locally on net10.0). The DiskWriterQueue race of #2127 no longer exists; the queue was removed in 198f0a672.
quarantine.gap: Back-to-back file-backed inserts into 100 recreated databases do not run in CI; the original race cannot recur, so the test is a candidate to retire as obsolete.

dispositions.invariant: Every test leg's results are uploaded and judged; no existing timeout, filter or partition changes.
dispositions.reason: Adds the Safety policy and Safety evidence jobs (10-minute limits) and a results upload for the .NET Framework leg, which uploaded nothing before; existing test steps keep their timeouts and filters.

dispositions.invariant: An active operation and its committed data remain protected from reentrant facade disposal.
dispositions.reason: Session close now explicitly rejects reentrant disposal before state changes; the replacement asserts native exclusion, continued session usability, final release and cold committed data.

dispositions.invariant: Rebuild must not dispose services still needed by a transaction cleanup tail.
dispositions.reason: The operation lease deliberately keeps maintenance out until cleanup returns; the replacement forces the cleanup interval and verifies cold committed data.

dispositions.invariant: An operation queued behind rebuild must not touch retired services or lose data.
dispositions.reason: Admission now waits before selecting services, so the operation succeeds against the replacement; both the queued write and a later write are verified after cold reopen.

dispositions.invariant: Every existing test workload and native-platform qualification remains mandatory, with runtime guards and complete candidate-matched results.
dispositions.reason: Registers inherited glibc/macOS Intel/Windows ARM64/f2fs jobs in the upstream aggregate; native filtered legs add provenance and discovery without narrowing their executed filters. TransactionHandle coverage is added to native filters. Missing or stale evidence now fails the aggregate.

dispositions.invariant: Bound readers never resume engine work after either explicit reader disposal or transaction completion.
dispositions.reason: An explicitly disposed reader now consistently throws ObjectDisposedException before entering the transaction guard, preserving earlier writes; the existing terminal rejection assertion changes exception type without being removed.

dispositions.invariant: All eight known-bad comparisons run with their required packed-commit feed, while permanent regression guards remain in ordinary runtime/platform tests. Unknown new repros remain scheduled.
dispositions.reason: Commit-pinned packages cannot restore in the ordinary repro matrix. The dedicated Regression proof workflow packs the real known-bad revision, executes strict before/after comparisons and validates provenance. Each substitution lists its permanent guard; matrix tests enforce that mapping.

dispositions.invariant: The existing plain/encrypted index-migration fault and repeated-recovery matrix remains executed with unchanged assertions.
dispositions.reason: The stacked branch retains failure databases and configuration for investigation and uploads them when present. This adds evidence retention without narrowing the eight boundary scenarios or making test failures optional.

dispositions.invariant: The existing plain/encrypted index-migration fault and repeated-recovery matrix remains executed with unchanged assertions.
dispositions.reason: The stacked branch retains failure databases and configuration for investigation and uploads them when present. This adds evidence retention without narrowing the eight boundary scenarios or making test failures optional.

dispositions.invariant: Every test selected by the native platform filters executes with runtime and hook guards; each session remains limited to 300 seconds and complete current-candidate evidence remains mandatory.
dispositions.reason: Run 36691368391 on 3b60d5aea exhausted the 300-second macOS Intel net10 session after 638 results with continued progress and no failed assertions; same-head net8 finished all 642 cases. Divide the unchanged selection into disjoint handles/admission/remainder sessions. Discovery verifies exactly one workload partition with no empty or aliased results; all sessions are declared in aggregate evidence and the runtime/hook guards execute in each. The discovery matcher also now follows VSTest case-insensitive FQN filtering so lowercase rebuild methods are accounted for. No tests or platforms are omitted.
